title: 2.1: drop the legacy CubricVision-* artifact names and delete the old CubricVision.exe
description: Follow-up raised by MPI-708 Phase 3. 2.0 dual-publishes CubricVision-* beside CubricStudio-* and keeps the old exe on updated Windows installs (decision (c), Fabio 2026-09-17). 2.1 removes both: full bundles must carry RETIRED_PATHS, and mpi-ci drops the old-slug mapping. Do not start before 2.0 is public. Detail: brief.md.
